ivy: can we isolate apac and continue others? prefer targeted fallback over full rollback.

ops-oncall: we can apply region override: /deploy traffic override model-router apac variant=v2.13.9 --sticky=true

sam: go for override. I'll warm fallback caches.

deploy-bot: Override applied: apac -> v2.13.9, global canary paused at 3%. cmd=ov-1829998888-01

ivy: apac 5xx back to baseline within 2m. no global spillover observed.

sre-lead: hold global ramp at 3% until we validate 30m of stable telemetry. Create ticket for tokenizer tweak.

ops-oncall: ticket INF-4903 opened, monitoring pinned. reconvene T+25m for stop/go.
